scripts.dev:mcp: bun run --cwd apps/mcp build && wrangler dev -c apps/mcp/wrangler.local.jsonc -c apps/api/wrangler.local.jsonc --port 8788 --local --persist-to apps/api/.wrangler/state
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web generate-routes && bun run cf-types && tsc -p packages/toolkit && tsc -p packages/helius && tsc -p packages/contracts && tsc -p packages/catalog && tsc -p packages/jupiter && tsc -p packages/phoenix && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/mcp && tsc -p packages/testbed && tsc -p apps/proof && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/mcp build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.deploy:api: bun run --cwd apps/api db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:mcp: bun run --cwd apps/mcp build && wrangler deploy -c apps/mcp/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:web: VITE_SOLANA_NETWORK=devnet bun run --cwd apps/web build && wrangler deploy -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:mcp && bun run deploy:api && bun run deploy:web
scripts.cf-types: wrangler types -c apps/api/wrangler.local.jsonc apps/api/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime false && wrangler types -c apps/mcp/wrangler.local.jsonc apps/mcp/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime false && wrangler types -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime false
scripts.test: bun test packages/toolkit/src packages/helius packages/jupiter/src packages/phoenix/src packages/catalog/src apps/api/src apps/mcp/src packages/testbed/src/privy-policy-denial.test.ts packages/testbed/src/spend-limit.test.ts packages/testbed/src/networks.test.ts apps/web/src
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run --cwd apps/api db:smoke:local && bun run test:e2e
